verdicts_or_reports.expected: Browse cards on French opens French and its 3 cards, overriding the previously selected browser deck.

steps: In card browser select Spanish from the deck dropdown.
Back to deck list; long press French and choose Browse cards.
Back and repeat French > Browse cards; Spanish still appears.

Long press comer, then tap mesa to select both.

Open mesa in editor: Tags: verb.
Back, More options > Undo Update Note, and repeat: mesa again gains verb.

Inspect toolbar and More options for deck search.
Rotate landscape and inspect toolbar and overflow again.

Browser Spanish/French counts and cards checked through drawer and deck context routes, dropdown persistence and rotation checked. Cancel after toggle/rotation preserved original tags. Reported stale browser deck overriding explicit French launch and absent deck-list search; developer could not reproduce those reports.
